title: Operator Readiness Checklist for Private Deployments (RBAC, Audit, KMS)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: produce an operator-facing, step-by-step readiness checklist and cross-team comms plan for Private/VPC/on-prem feature launches that include RBAC, audit-logging, and KMS integration. This ticket coordinates release notes segmentation, runbooks, training, and the support escalation playbook. Goals: 1) Ensure SRE and Solutions Engineers can onboard customers to private deployments with minimal friction; 2) Confirm compliance artifacts (audit samples, key lifecycle guidance) are available for enterprise security reviews; 3) Align Release Notes and Console UI copy across Console, Docs, and SDKs; 4) Validate rollback and upgrade procedures in the runbook.
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with SRE, Security, Docs, Console PMs. Agreed on scope: RBAC matrix, audit retention defaults, KMS key rotation guidance, and support playbook.

2026-03-03: Security provided initial audit sample logs and mapping to SIEM fields (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-audit-schema). Noted that audit retention defaults differ by region—ops to confirm storage costs.

2026-03-04: Decision: default RBAC roles will be 'operator', 'observer', 'admin'; will add custom role template later. Trade-off: fewer default roles reduces confusion but requires role templates to be flexible for large customers.
2026-03-05: Docs owner assigned (Anika Rao). Draft release note sections created in Docs repo (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/private-release-notes/DRAFT). Need final copy by 2026-03-12.
2026-03-06: Console PM (Diego) completed console copy for RBAC screens; queued for UX review. UX flagged a small language change to clarify 'operator' vs 'admin' privileges.

2026-03-08: Support runbook skeleton created and uploaded as runbook-v1 (link: https://drive.redwood.ai/PrivateOps/runbooks/runbook-v1.md). Includes diagnostic commands, log collection checklist, and rollback flag instructions.
2026-03-09: Engineering provided a compatibility matrix for KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Note: Azure needs a small shim for key wrap/unlock—ENG estimated 2d of work.
2026-03-10: Training session scheduled for Solutions Engineers and Tier-2 Support on 2026-03-15. Action: Product to finalize customer-facing KB articles and tech checklist by 2026-03-13.
acceptance_criteria: Operator readiness checklist published in Confluence with step-by-step onboarding checklist and links to artifacts
Release notes sections for RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS finalized and staged in Docs repo
Runbook tested end-to-end in staging with documented rollback steps and observed timings
Support escalations playbook and canned responses added to Support portal
Training session delivered and attendance recorded; follow-up feedback captured and actioned
